            const navTexts = new Set();
            for (const menu of menus) {
                for (const item of menu.querySelectorAll("li")) {
                    const text = item.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (text) navTexts.add(text);
                }
            }

            slugToMatch = tags.find(tag => navTexts.has(tag));
            if (!slugToMatch) return;
        }

        for (const menu of menus) {
            let matched = false;
            for (const item of menu.querySelectorAll("li")) {
                const text = item.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!text) continue;

                if (text === slugToMatch) {
                    item.classList.add("active-article-tag");
                    matched = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (matched) break;
        }
    }
